nodes.label: Partial registration recovery
nodes.rationale: If account persistence succeeds but session persistence fails, retain the account and report SESSION_WRITE_FAILED without claiming that sign-in succeeded.

nodes.label: Exact record schema validation
nodes.rationale: Reject extra fields, invalid primitives, roles and timestamps, and duplicate normalized usernames. Consumers retain read failures and derive safe display fallbacks rather than mutate from fallback data.

nodes.label: Feature-prop-driven authenticated navigation
nodes.rationale: AuthenticatedNavbar receives availableFeatures, initially empty. Reading enables Blogs, writing enables Write, and admin enables Dashboard and Users only for administrator sessions, allowing later slices to enable links without exposing unavailable features.

nodes.label: App-owned router and session snapshot
nodes.rationale: App owns the single BrowserRouter and in-memory session snapshot. Login and Register notify onSessionChange only after a session has been saved; the implementation uses useState and useEffect without context.

nodes.label: Shared browser-error E2E fixture
nodes.rationale: Capture browser errors before navigation and assert an empty collection across desktop and mobile projects. E2E specifications and fixtures were written but not executed; hosting and visual runtime behavior remain unverified.
